text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Verxina announced her entry in the 
Victoria Mile to face Vivlos in a 
showdown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If running the Tiara route pushed Vivlos's 
dream further away... then the Trainer 
promises to give her a race just as 
fulfilling as the one in Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A serious showdown with her older sister 
that she had never even dreamed of. Vivlos 
showed her sheer joy and got all fired up!
